name: es-foral-income-tax-savings
description: Tax 2026 savings income and gains of an ordinary resident of Bizkaia, Álava, Gipuzkoa or Navarra. Covers property-gain measurement and the local acquisition update, habitual-home and small-disposal exemptions, replacement-home reinvestment, proceeds reinvested in an insured life annuity, dividends and financial-income expenses, listed and unlisted share disposals, nonbusiness crypto sales, swaps, fees and loss timing, landlord income, expenses and depreciation, and the 2026 foreign crypto custody balances with the 2027 reporting procedure. Use for ganancias patrimoniales, renta del ahorro, dividendos, venta de acciones, criptomonedas, permuta, reinversión en vivienda habitual, rendimientos del capital inmobiliario in the foral territories. Load es-foral-income-tax for residence, the savings scales and the annual return. Split unchanged from es-foral-income-tax on 6 November 2026.
